audit.whatIsWrong: full phases[0..5].side all read 'Skill' with Sivir-favorable why-text, while content win[0..5] already correctly says Varus wins those stages and the packet flags this exact contradiction (Sivir wins 56.03% overall but the chart gives Varus 6/7 stages).
audit.why: Varus's charged Piercing Arrow out-ranges Sivir's auto and boomerang for the whole early game, Blighted Quiver stacking adds burst on top, and Chain of Corruption roots into a stacked all-in at 6 — Sivir only catches up once crit/attack-speed items and R let her close the range gap.
audit.corrected: See chart edits — side moved to Varus for phases 0-5 with matching why, and phases[6].side moved to Sivir to match the already-correct win[6].

audit.why: Content spikes correctly track Varus's early/mid poke and level-6 root all-in, and Sivir's 2+ item flip once crit/attack-speed lets her out-DPS at range.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d are copy-paste bleed (tradeGood/tradeBad under unrelated titles); breakdown.cooldowns has no cooldown numbers.
audit.why: Chain of Corruption (R) is 100/80/60s and roots/chains into an all-in; Piercing Arrow (Q) charges on a 16-12s base cooldown; Hail of Arrows (E) is 18-10s and carries the self-heal reduction Sivir should time Grievous Wounds around.

edits.after: W-detonate trades win the poke war outright — farm behind minions, don't contest at range.

edits.after: His range and stacked Blight burst keep winning every poke exchange through 4-5.

edits.before: Q the contact both ways, W-bounce the duo, walk — the trade taxed two people and refunded your mana bar.
edits.after: Bait a charged Piercing Arrow or his R chain, then Spell Shield it — a blocked cast heals and speeds you clear.

edits.before: - Varus Chain of Corruption: matchup-defining — The spreading root starts dives — stand apart from allies when it flies. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E Spell Shield like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
